Statement: I got stuck in a revolving door at a shopping centre in Leeds and had to be rescued by security.
When I was on holiday in Cornwall, I accidentally superglued my flip-flops to the beach hut floor and had to be cut free by a lifeguard.
My family and I got lost in the New Forest for three hours on a school trip, and we had to spend the night in our tent.
I once set up a lemonade stand in my front garden and made £50 in one day, which I used to buy a new bike.
I've never seen a single Star Wars film all the way through, even though I own all of them.
I've been banned from a trampoline park for doing a backflip into the foam pit fully clothed in a suit.
I accidentally ordered 40 rubber ducks online instead of 4 and they're still in my wardrobe.
I was a professional snail trainer for a summer when I was 17 and competed in the UK snail racing championships.
I once confidently gave a stranger directions to the train station and sent them the wrong way.
My mum accidentally ordered a whole box of my favourite breakfast cereal, so we had to have it for every meal for a month.
When I was little I thought the moon followed our car, so I waved at it every night.
I was on the winning team of a local quiz competition when I was 12 and we won a year's supply of pizza.
I once spent my entire A-levels writing a series of novels that I'm still trying to get published.
I once spent an entire weekend trying to return a faulty toy car to Argos, but they kept sending me to the wrong store.
I was a contestant on the UK version of 'The Weakest Link' when I was 15 and made it to the final round.
I named my first goldfish Gordon Ramsay because it kept spitting its food out.
I was once on the big screen at a football match because I was the only person wearing a wizard hat.
I once tried to make toast in the microwave and set off every smoke alarm in the house.
I won a goldfish at a funfair and it lived for eleven years.
I once fell into a fish pond while trying to take a photo of a frog.
